LanguageData.TKSRagdollAdjustToolTip: All tosses will be adjusted by this magnitude (default 1).
LanguageData.TKSRagdollMinStunDescrip: Add x ticks of stun when any pawn lands after a toss (by default, pawns are only stunned if they impact something during the toss)
LanguageData.TKSRagdollUseJump: Use vanilla jump flight for tosses
LanguageData.TKSRagdollUseJumpToolTip:
Tossed pawns, items and corpses fly in an arc with a shadow, the way jump packs and fleshbeasts do, instead of Ragdoll's own movement (tween, the default).

Compared to tween:
- While in the air they can't be shot or hit again.
- A second explosion won't add to a toss that's already in the air.
- They fly straight to where they land, over the cells in between instead of through them.
